integrity: Proof and exact finite checker are embedded; no unverified generalization from numerical samples; known parking-function volume formula cited separately.
scientific_limitations: Proves a Euclidean inball phase law and complete optimal-center classification only for the two-row initial-supply family (1,t), t>=0, zero lower vector, and native matrix/Frobenius metric; no corresponding claim for arbitrary supply vectors, metrics on equivalent flow coordinates, or independent certification.
title: An inball phase transition and a parking-function incenter polytope in two-row generalized Pitman–Stanley geometry
